resources.string: Hints around the app that point out features. Tap one to turn them off.
Joy-Cons send input about twice as often for smoother motion and quicker buttons but uses more battery.
Ignore this device\'s motion in Eden
Eden adds this device\'s gyro to Player 1, which makes controller motion stutter. Lifted when the Virtual Gamepad and DSU are both off.
Stand a Joy-Con on its rail on a flat surface to move this device\'s pointer. L or R clicks, ZL or ZR right-clicks and the stick scrolls.
Sends Home, Back and Screenshot bindings through a virtual keyboard instead of the shell, for quicker keys with DSU alone.
Open emulators on the main screen
On a device with two screens, starts the emulator on the main one rather than the screen this app is on.
Support on Ko-fi - tips go towards controllers and devices for development and testing (and coffee!)
